how: We read the website of every Charlotte wedding florist listed on Lazo (187 listings, 151 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: bridal gown shops, wedding venues and a planner that landed in this category, same-day delivery shops, a bouquet-preservation studio and a rental company. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Do you design on site with installation and teardown, or deliver finished arrangements? That is the big price difference.
What holds up in Charlotte heat for an outdoor summer ceremony, and what wilts? Ask what is in season for your month and what gets shipped in.
Can I see a full wedding's florals at a budget like mine, not just a bouquet photo?

picks.name: Little Dove Floral
picks.blurb: Little Dove Floral is Rachel Hiemer's Charlotte studio, garden-inspired wedding and event design with a collaborative, full-service approach. She has worked with flowers since 17, from a grocery-store floral department to assistant manager of a Milwaukee flower shop, before moving to Charlotte in 2018 and leaving the corporate world.

picks.name: Two Classic Turtles Wedding and Event Design
picks.blurb: Two Classic Turtles does wedding and event florals and decor from Rock Hill, SC, with a self-described Carolina girl's love of setting a beautiful table. Full design or a la carte finishing touches for couples who already have most vendors in place, and consultations are free.

picks.name: Chelish Moore Flowers
picks.blurb: Chelish Moore started her wedding floral business in 2000 with one goal, flowers every bride would cherish, and says the goal has not changed as the business grew. Kannapolis-based, specializing in florals and wedding decor, with corporate and event work too.

picks.name: In Bloom Ltd
picks.blurb: In Bloom has been part of the Charlotte floral market for over 20 years under founder and master designer Jay Lugibihl, whose love of growing things started on a farm in rural Ohio. Timeless arrangements for weddings, events and receptions since 2002.

picks.name: Gather Flower Studio
picks.blurb: Fine art floristry with a hug is how Gather Flower Studio describes its Uptown Charlotte shop. Flower-focused design that uses greenery and filler with intention, locally grown stems, and wedding work from tabletops to installations, plus a mobile flower cart for build-your-own bouquet bars.

picks.name: Lily Greenthumb's Wedding and Event Design
picks.blurb: In 2009 the founder of Lily Greenthumb's walked away from corporate America, enrolled in design school and signed a studio lease a month later. The Charlotte studio creates bespoke florals from simple social affairs to large floral installations.

picks.name: Nectar
picks.blurb: Nectar is a small Charlotte boutique whose team brings over 23 years of combined experience in hospitality, venue coordination, wedding planning and floral design to the table. Bouquets, centerpieces, installations and client gifts for weddings, with a flower shop for everyday orders.

picks.name: Proper Flower
picks.blurb: Melissa Martin Julien founded Proper Flower after years on the Matthew Robbins Design team in New York, producing luxury events from Tokyo to Tulum. Her Stallings studio handles floral design and production for weddings, corporate and social events around Charlotte.

picks.name: LiviLove floral & events design
picks.blurb: Olga runs LiviLove in Fort Mill, florals and decor for weddings and events with more than 15 years of experience. The site is written in her own exuberant voice, promising lush color and fragrance for occasions of any size.

picks.name: Gold Hill Flower Co.
picks.blurb: Gold Hill Flower Co. is a flower farm in the historic gold-mining village of Gold Hill, started in 2019 when the owners moved back to Drew's hometown. Locally grown stems for small weddings and events, plus U-pick, a self-serve stand and seasonal workshops.

picks.name: What's Up Buttercup
picks.blurb: What's Up Buttercup is a Rock Hill floral designer who positions herself as a Charlotte wedding florist, with personal arrangements delivered to Rock Hill and Fort Mill on the side. The site shows event work for Foundation For The Carolinas and Treehouse Vineyards.

picks.name: STILL WATERS FARM AND GARDENS
picks.blurb: Still Waters Farm and Gardens is a family-run flower farm and floral design studio in the Mountain View area of Hickory. Garden-style wedding and event arrangements built from flowers and greenery harvested fresh from their own fields, grown with natural, sustainable practices.
